data.name: Monster Punk
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO THE FESTIVAL OF SKILL & SPECTACLE

In a high-octane universe worshipping speed and destruction, the loudest religion is the arena. Winners are treated like myths while losers are stripped for parts. You step into this mayhem as a “nobody” driver with a dream and a hunger to become the champion of champions.

Monster Punk is a brutal vehicular combat roguelite where every run is another shot at the title.

Enter a series of deadly arena challenges, complete each objective, and survive the enemies trying to eliminate you. Collect your winnings, upgrade your ride, and prepare for increasingly dangerous challenges and brutal boss battles.

Lose, and your run is over.

The Challenges: Each arena throws you into a new objective built around vehicular combat, high-speed driving, stunts, and destruction.

The Winnings: Complete challenges to earn prize money, then spend it on upgrades that strengthen your vehicle and shape how you approach the rest of the run.

The Bosses: Face powerful arena bosses that put your vehicle, your build, and your driving skills to the test.

The Run: Keep winning, keep upgrading, and push deeper into the championship. One defeat ends your run. Survive until the end to claim the title of Champion of Champions.

Owning the arena requires high-speed precision, controlled chaos, and plenty of firepower.

Agility: Jump, boost, drift, and flip your way through the arena, using the environment to outmaneuver your enemies.

Firepower: Use heavy weapons and brute force to destroy enemy vehicles before they destroy you.

Settle scores and survive the championship with shared-screen multiplayer for up to four players.

PvP Showdown: Face off in competitive arena battles for up to four players and prove who truly owns the arena.

Co-op Campaign: Team up with up to four players and fight through the full roguelite campaign together.

Turn your winnings into power. Purchase upgrades throughout the run, strengthen your vehicle, and create a build capable of surviving the championship’s toughest challenges.

Earn new garage parts, expand your options, and build a machine worthy of the Champion of Champions.

data.short_description: Dominate the ultimate motorsport roguelite. Smash, blast, and pull off wild stunts through extreme arena challenges. Fight through each run alone or in co-op, defeat brutal bosses, and earn the cash to upgrade your ride. Lose, and your run is over. Rise from “nobody” to Arena Champion

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit only
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

data.legal_notice:
Age Rating & Content Warning:
This game features animated vehicular and combat violence. Players engage in high-speed heists, vehicular combat, and shootouts against robotic enemies. Expect explosions, crashes, and destruction physics, but no gore or realistic injury. Player discretion is advised for those sensitive to intense action and destruction-based gameplay.
